purpose: Pins the intent-router pre-release AWA is proven against, and the EXACT router contract-version strings the seam test asserts. Neither repo's own CI tests the router<->AWA seam; this pin + consumer/tests/test_consumer_seam.py is that test. A router contract-version bump (v1 -> v2) or a rename MUST break the seam test.

router.install_note: Install/point the router at this ref (e.g. `pip install -e <clone>` or PYTHONPATH to a clone checked out at the pinned ref) so `import intent_router` resolves. The seam test SKIPS (never fails) when the router is not importable — that is the kernel-first / off-switch property (make verify passes router-uninstalled).

assertions: the router's authoritative catalog-verify passes AWA's real catalog with zero Tier A/B/C banned terms
AWA's egress-terms snapshot is a superset of the router's composed Tier A/B tiers (drift guard)
